summary.t: Big round ears, a long tail, and a belly full of light.

text.t:
Round ears full of light and a tail that leaves the body in a long curve. It sits well on a shelf or a bedside table, and the tail gives it the look of something passing through.

The wood is left bare on the body — hand-sanded pine, with no paint over it.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
